title: Forecast Revised — CFDI4 Crest 21.8 ft, Moderate

fields.headline: Upstream rain raises the crest to moderate
fields.narration: The forecast cycle moves forward. It is now just after 6:00 PM on Tuesday. Heavy rain fell across the upper Cedar River basin all afternoon, and at 5:00 PM the gauge on the Route 38 bridge read 13.1 feet, above action stage. The duty desk printer has just produced the 6:00 PM flood warning from NWS Quad Cities. It reads: 'TEST... FLOOD WARNING... TEST. National Weather Service Quad Cities, 600 PM CDT Tuesday April 20 2027. This is an exercise message. The flood warning continues for the Cedar River at Cedar Ford, CFDI4. What changed: 2.4 inches of rain fell in the upper basin today. The forecast crest is raised from 18.2 feet to 21.8 feet and delayed from 6 AM to 8 PM Friday. Moderate flooding is forecast. The river will rise above flood stage Wednesday afternoon, above 19.0 feet around 8 AM Friday, and crest near 21.8 feet at 8 PM Friday. At 19.0 feet, the Cedar Hollow neighborhood floods, Route 38 bottoms close and the wastewater plant access road is under water.' The phones at the annex start ringing.
keyFacts: Latest issuance: NWS Quad Cities flood warning for CFDI4, 6:00 PM CDT Tuesday 20 April 2027 (it replaces the 5:15 AM issuance)
Observed: 13.1 ft at 5:00 PM Tuesday, above action stage (13.0 ft)
Forecast crest: 21.8 ft, MODERATE, at 8:00 PM Friday (was 18.2 ft, Minor, at 6:00 AM Friday): up 3.6 ft and 14 hours later
Forecast to pass 19.0 ft around 8:00 AM Friday: Cedar Hollow, Route 38 bottoms and the wastewater plant access road
Forecast to pass flood stage (15.0 ft) Wednesday afternoon: River Road south of Mill Street and Riverside Park
fields.expectedAction: EM records the 6:00 PM Tuesday issuance and the 13.1 ft reading on the River Status Board, treats it as a material revision, and moves to Full activation because the crest is at or above moderate (EOP 5). From this issuance, 19.0 ft is about 62 hours out and the crest about 74 hours out. EM issues the voluntary Cedar Hollow advisory and counts back 18 hours from 8:00 AM Friday, which puts the order deadline at 2:00 PM Thursday (EOP 6.1). PIO says: 'The forecast crest has been revised from 18.2 ft to 21.8 ft, Moderate, 8 PM Friday, 6:00 PM Tuesday issuance.' LEV steps up patrols for action stage and requests the bag and pump shortfall through Logistics. WWTP plans to move the portable chemicals and generators above the plant's flood line while the access road is still open.
fields.facilitatorNote: Hand the printout to EM and put the issuance on the wall-screen River Status Board. Make sure players use the 6:00 PM issuance for every decision and do not wait for the next one. Listen for any message that calls the 21.8 ft crest 'major' or says the levee will be overtopped. The co-op's noon deadline from Call 1 has now passed, so make SimCell call back if nobody gave the co-op an answer.
